annotations.title: Edit a Meta campaign / ad set / ad

description: Update an EXISTING campaign, ad set, or ad — rename, change its daily or lifetime budget, bid strategy, bid or cost cap, minimum ROAS, end time or optimization goal, retarget (ad sets), swap an ad's creative (creativeId, or imageHash / videoId from upload_meta_asset) or its UTMs (urlTags; Meta keeps creatives fixed, so a new one is built and the ad points at it, the old one kept), or change status (PAUSED / ACTIVE / ARCHIVED). Budget and bid fields go on one object per call, creative fields on an ad. Everything changed is read back. Pass objectId (from list_meta_ads) + adAccountId. Setting something ACTIVE can start REAL AD SPEND — show the user what will run + its budget, get a yes, then pass confirm:true. Pausing and renaming are always safe and always reversible. ARCHIVING IS NOT: Meta treats an archived object as DELETED and refuses to bring it back — every later edit answers "This campaign has been deleted, so you can only edit the name" (measured live 2026-08-05), archiving a campaign takes its ad sets and ads down with it, and the only way back is to duplicate it as a new object. Use PAUSED unless the user has said they are finished with it for good.

bidAmountUsd.description: ad sets: the bid or cost cap, account currency (BID_CAP / COST_CAP)

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to set ACTIVE, or to change budget, bid, schedule, targeting or creative on a LIVE object

creativeId.description: ads: point the ad at this existing creative

dailyBudgetUsd.description: new daily budget in the AD ACCOUNT's currency (historical name — not necessarily USD; ad-set or campaign level); the reply reads it back with the currency code

dsaBeneficiary.description: ad sets: EU ad transparency, who the ad promotes. Meta requires it once targeting reaches the EU; retarget into the EU without it and the ad account default, else the profile's brand name, else the Page name is used

dsaPayor.description: ad sets: EU ad transparency, who pays (defaults to dsaBeneficiary)

endTime.description: ad sets: ISO 8601 end, or "ongoing" for a daily-budget ad set

imageHash.description: ads: new image (hash from upload_meta_asset); the rest of the creative is kept

lifetimeBudgetUsd.description: lifetime budget in the ad account's currency (needs an end time; Meta refuses lowering it below 110% of what is spent)

minRoas.description: ad sets: minimum ROAS, e.g. 1.5 (LOWEST_COST_WITH_MIN_ROAS, optimization goal VALUE)

objectId.description: the campaign / ad set / ad id (from list_meta_ads)

optimizationGoal.description: ad sets: new optimization goal; when Meta refuses a change on a set that has delivered, its reason is passed on

status.description: ACTIVE starts spend (needs confirm:true); PAUSED / ARCHIVED are safe

targeting.description: replacement targeting spec (ad sets) — a Meta targeting object

urlTags.description: ads: new UTM query string Meta appends to clicks, or false for none

name: update_meta_object
title: Edit a Meta campaign / ad set / ad
